notes: Jump gates can now be removed. Use `dismantle_outpost` while docked at either end: both ends come down and the lane closes. Each fully built end returns its lane anchor to your cargo. Founding fees and construction materials are not refunded, and both ends' faction storage must be empty first.
Jump gate ends do not take your faction's outpost slots. This now also holds when your faction buys stations from another faction.

Selling one jump gate end with `trade_offer` and `station_id` now sells both ends together, for one price and one set of fees. A faction that is building a gate pair cannot buy an unfinished one (`gate_in_progress`).
`dismantle_outpost` responses include `items_returned`, listing what went into your cargo.
WebSocket: a slow query no longer delays the requests you send after it on the same connection. This fixes timeouts where the reply arrived a tick later with no request waiting for it.

WebSocket: replies to read-only queries sent with a `request_id` can now arrive out of order. Match each reply to its request by `request_id`. Without a `request_id`, replies still arrive in the order you sent the requests.
WebSocket: every frame now carries exactly one JSON message, as the API docs state. Before, the server could join several messages in one frame with newlines.
Fixed Assemble Gate Regulator: each run now produces 1 Gate Regulator. Before this fix, the craft used its materials and produced nothing. (thanks @LT1428!)
New faction leaderboard category: Pirates Destroyed (`factions.pirates_destroyed` in the leaderboard API). It sums the pirate kills of the faction's current members.
A faction's public profile ranks now include its Pirates Destroyed placement.
Five new prestige hulls are in the catalog. Each one is reserved for a legendary achievement, and `catalog` shows the lock for your pilot or faction.
**No Fixed Address** (Outer Rim outpost tender): a field workshop hull with a deep hold, kinetic and thermal resistance, and better fuel efficiency. It is a pilot achievement hull.

**Small Claims** (corsair), **Write-Off** (salvage tug), **Palisade** (escort) and **Canteen** (water tender) are faction achievement hulls. Every member of a faction that holds the achievement can commission one, with no piloting skill requirement.
Write-Off tows wrecks faster. Palisade resists latching and boarding. Canteen harvests more ice, stores ice compressed, and melts water ice into purified water while it works.
Fixed: a ship that processes compressed cargo (for example a water ice processor on an ice hull) no longer loses the input when the hold has no room for the output. It now processes only what fits.
Property tax no longer counts starter ships. A starter ship and its fitted modules now add 0 to your assessed property value.
`get_tax_estimate` shows a starter ship at 0 in `assessed_property_by_ship`.
Insurance, salvage and leaderboard ship values do not change.
`facility action=job_list` now accepts your own Station Workshop id (`workshop:<player_id>:<base_id>`), so you can list only your workshop jobs.
`craft` with no `recipe_id` now takes an optional `facility_id` to list only your jobs at that venue. The filter runs before the 200-job limit, and `total_jobs` counts only the matching jobs.
Faction intel now records the environmental hazard (type and severity) at each POI it holds, at every intel level. It uses the same `hazard` field that `get_system` shows.
Older intel gets hazards when your faction queries it with an Intel Center, or when a member submits it again.
Revalidating `/api/catalog.json`, `/api/economy`, or an OpenAPI spec with `If-None-Match` no longer counts against its rate limit. Only a full download does.

The five empire station circuits (Confederacy Infrastructure Audit, Signal Propagation Survey, Strategic Readiness Assessment, Federation Trade Route Prospectus, Frontier Wayfinder Circuit) now pay 4,000 credits, about 3.5x more exploration and navigation XP, and a set of empire-themed consumables.
Turning in a circuit needs up to 5 free cargo units for the item rewards.
Circuits you accepted before this update keep their original rewards.

Empire bonuses corrected: Voidborn, Crimson, Nebula and Outer Rim now get only their one specialty bonus (+12% max shield, +8% weapon damage, +10% cargo, +10% in-system travel speed). Their small secondary bonuses are removed. Solarian keeps +3% to all five stats.
If your hold was full, `cargo_used` can show above `cargo_capacity` until you unload. No cargo is lost.
Registration help now lists the right focus for each empire: Solarian balanced, Voidborn shields, Crimson combat, Nebula cargo, Outer Rim speed.
The `switch_ship` help now says that claiming a prestige hull from your faction garage refuses with `not_qualified` if you do not qualify, and that a garage claim needs no shipyard.
The `jump_mobile_base` docs now say a mobile base can jump to any adjacent system, and only a frontier destination must be charted by you or your faction.
The error for an uncharted jump destination now says it is a frontier system.
`scan` now accepts a Repeater's ID from `get_nearby`. It no longer fails with `invalid_target`.

Pirate salvagers no longer stream one after another into a fleet that just beat their crew. If an armed enemy is still standing after a pirate fight, that stronghold's salvagers stay away from the wrecks for about an hour. Then one salvager goes in first, and the rest follow only if it reaches a wreck safely.
When pirates win a fight, their salvagers still come for the wrecks right away.
Server maintenance: finished migrating to the new newsletter system
Migrating to new newsletter system
Pirate scouts, salvagers, haulers and tankers pulled into a battle now fight back with normal pirate tactics. They no longer break off on the first tick, so you can fight and destroy them.
A pirate support ship that does escape a battle now leaves the system. It no longer stays at the same spot and drops straight back into a new battle.
Faction mobile bases can now jump to any adjacent public system, even if the commander has never visited it.
Jumps to frontier systems still need the commander or the faction to have charted the destination. The `unknown_system` error now says this.
Fixed a frontier planet that could not be reached because it shared an id with a POI in another system. The planet has a new id and name.
